risks.title: Inside bend radius R1.0 is tight for 1.5 mm steel
risks.rationale: Bend radius below ~1x material thickness risks cracking on the outer fiber.
risks.mitigation: Increase inside radius to >= material thickness (>=1.5 mm).

risks.title: Ø14 hole only 15 mm from bend may distort
risks.rationale: Holes within ~2.5x (thickness + radius) of a bend deform during forming.
risks.mitigation: Move the hole further from the bend or pierce after forming.

risks.title: Edge distance on Ø10 hole (18 mm) is acceptable
risks.rationale: Edge distance is adequate but not toleranced.

tasks.title: Verify hole-to-bend distance against forming guidelines
